stem: The author’s primary purpose for writing the selection is to —

options.label: A
options.text: share interesting facts about a large species of bird

options.label: B
options.text: explain how the staff at a resort is taking care of a large bird as it grows up

options.label: C
options.text: tell about the methods bird experts use to encourage birds to fly

options.label: D
options.text: describe how a lost bird caused problems for tourists at a beach resort
